_comment: Monolith-growth census baseline (DS-016). The shared rhiz-lint monolith-growth check (rhiz_growth engine, from rhizome tools-stable) reads this and bands charlotte's hand-grown source against the thresholds. `rhiz census` drills the bands. Scan is scoped to src/ (the source of truth); the root crawl.js / crawl-render.js are BUILD OUTPUTS generated from src/ by build.mjs and are excluded. Files already over threshold at adoption (2026-07-18) are recorded in keep_whole as a baseline snapshot with their size-at-adoption, so the stale-detector re-nags only if they GROW past the stale factor — the census is adopted as a forward tripwire, not a demand to partition stable code today.

src/report.js.reason: pre-existing at census adoption — report generator/templating; baseline snapshot, not yet evaluated for partition. Stale-detector re-nags if it grows >1.25x.

src/crawl.js.reason: pre-existing at census adoption — crawler core (source of the generated root crawl.js); baseline snapshot, not yet evaluated for partition. Stale-detector re-nags if it grows >1.25x.

src/report-templates/tracker-template.js.reason: pre-existing at census adoption — a single HTML/JS report template (mostly embedded markup); cohesive as one template. Stale-detector re-nags if it grows >1.25x.
